description: Codex ended its turn with a long multi-line diagnostic script for the user to run elsewhere. The model re-types such a block (it joined the lines with '; '), so the verbatim check rightly drops its copy; the agent's transcript reply carries the exact fenced block, which must surface as the copyable.
capture:
› the duplex setting keeps resetting on the office printer


• Probably a per-queue default in CUPS overriding the driver. The quickest way to tell is to collect every place it could be set.

  Worked for 3s • 9:12 AM


› can you give me a command to collect all of that from the desktop

[visible screen]
• Run this on the office desktop. It gathers the print queue, CUPS service and driver settings into /tmp/printer-report.txt. It doesn’t change anything.

  {
    echo '=== System ==='
    uname -a
    printf 'Session: %s\n' "$XDG_SESSION_TYPE"

    echo
    echo '=== Printer queues ==='
    lpstat -t 2>&1
    lpoptions -l 2>&1

    echo
    echo '=== CUPS service ==='
    systemctl is-active cups 2>&1
    journalctl -u cups --since today --no-pager 2>&1 | tail -50

    echo
    echo '=== USB devices ==='
    for d in /dev/usb/lp*; do
      [ -e "$d" ] && ls -l "$d"
    done
    lsusb 2>&1

    echo
    echo '=== Config files ==='
    sudo grep -RInsE 'duplex|media|resolution' \
      /etc/cups/printers.conf /etc/cups/cupsd.conf \
      "$HOME/.cups" 2>/dev/null | head -100
  } 2>&1 | tee /tmp/printer-report.txt

  Send me the contents of /tmp/printer-report.txt and I can tell which setting forces single-sided output.

  Worked for 7s • 9:13 AM
